events.title: Washington's army retreats across the Delaware
events.description: The last of George Washington's beaten Continental Army crossed the Delaware into Pennsylvania, taking every boat to stop British pursuit. Weeks later he crossed back to strike at Trenton.
events.html: The last of George Washington's beaten Continental Army crossed the Delaware into Pennsylvania, taking every boat to stop British pursuit. Weeks later he crossed back to strike at Trenton.

events.title: Pius IX defines the Immaculate Conception
events.description: In the bull Ineffabilis Deus, Pope Pius IX declared as dogma that the Virgin Mary was conceived without original sin. Other Christian traditions do not accept the doctrine.
events.html: In the bull Ineffabilis Deus, Pope Pius IX declared as dogma that the Virgin Mary was conceived without original sin. Other Christian traditions do not accept the doctrine.

events.title: The United States and Britain declare war on Japan
events.description: Franklin Roosevelt asked Congress to declare war, calling 7 December 'a date which will live in infamy'. Congress agreed within the hour, and Britain also declared war on Japan.
events.html: Franklin Roosevelt asked Congress to declare war, calling 7 December 'a date which will live in infamy'. Congress agreed within the hour, and Britain also declared war on Japan.

events.title: John Lennon is shot dead in New York
events.description: Mark David Chapman shot John Lennon outside the Dakota building in Manhattan. The killing of the former Beatle prompted vigils around the world.
events.html: Mark David Chapman shot John Lennon outside the Dakota building in Manhattan. The killing of the former Beatle prompted vigils around the world.

events.title: Leaders of Russia, Ukraine and Belarus agree to dissolve the USSR
events.description: Meeting in the Belovezha Forest, Boris Yeltsin, Leonid Kravchuk and Stanislav Shushkevich declared that the Soviet Union had ceased to exist and created the Commonwealth of Independent States.
